# Hut weekend

## Tuesday 3 March 2026

We reach Brig on the train from Bern at 09:58.

Our post bus to Blatten leaves Brig at 10:20.

Allow at least 25 minutes to change at Brig: the bus stop is a long walk from platform 9.

We reach the Belalp hut at 15:30. The room is booked for the night of 3 March only.

## Wednesday 4 March 2026

We check out at 10:00.
